scientific_integrity: Public proof establishes every parameter case by algebraic Routh-Hurwitz inequalities. Finite rational verification is supplemental only. Source model is for two pathogens; the arbitrary-finite-n system is explicitly constructed here.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for exchangeable SIRS pathogens with finite positive rates and exponential first-order risk-perception smoothing; strictly local stability only. No claim of global convergence, heterogeneous pathogens, or arbitrary coupling networks. Possible unindexed literature and limited access to one historical full text remain risks.
title: All-lag coexistence stability for arbitrarily many exchangeable behaviorally coupled pathogens
